$comment: Canonical gate for the exported repository. Checks run in apps/web; retained app-local config describes the standalone layout.

prepare.$why: Verse worktree of gewijzigde lockfile: eerst installeren, anders faalt elke check op iets wat niets met de wijziging te maken heeft.

checks.$why: Het typecheck-script van de repo, anders tsc -b bij project references (Vite), anders tsc --noEmit. Lockfiles in when: een dependency-update kan types breken.
checks.needsHint: npm ci (of pnpm install / yarn install)

checks.$why: Alleen de tests die bij de gewijzigde bestanden horen (vitest related); na een dependency- of config-wijziging alle tests (fullOn).
checks.run: if printf '%s\n' {files} | grep -qE '(^|/)(package\.json|package-lock\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml|yarn\.lock|vite(st)?\.config\.[cm]?[jt]s)$'; then npx --no-install vitest run --passWithNoTests; else npx --no-install vitest related --run --passWithNoTests {files}; fi

checks.$why: Focused acceptance of the independent host, real provider input/stream contracts, attachment boundaries, persistence and changed UI controllers. No historical Codex adapter tests or real account credentials. Limit Node file concurrency to two: the full 1367-case run passed at this setting, while the unbounded focused gate exhausted the streaming test polling window under concurrent UI load. Assertions and per-test deadlines remain unchanged. The isolated focused run with file concurrency two passed in 137.258 seconds; concurrent gate execution reached the old 180-second whole-check budget with zero assertion failures and 38 cancelled tests. A bounded 360-second check budget allows completion under shared-machine load without changing individual test deadlines.

Required genuine Claude-seat inference with real terminal, custom MCP, owned browser, acceptance recovery and ownership persistence. Six cases run on their own configured server; none are skipped for missing credentials.

checks.$why: Dedicated gated SSE fixture has its own server and test discovery. Always replay the streaming, cancellation and attachment draft-correction UI checks separately from the normal app suite.

Eight pre-execution validator cases for the opt-in real-provider probe: authoritative native replies are accepted; foreign replies, attachments, unexpected tools, batches, order violations and duplicates are rejected. This flag starts no server, model or effect.
Local desktop lifecycle, strict backend identity probe and renderer isolation; synthetic HTTP servers and child processes only. No Electron installation or GUI required for these Node tests.
